_about: Gemma's lines for the recipe book (recipe-book-ux.md sections 7 and 8). Content editor owns the wording; docs/gemma-voice-guide.md applies. Where a value is a list, rotate without repeating in a visit. {placeholders} are filled by the page. Every line stays under 100 characters (the phone chat's Line size).

idea.first: I've had an idea for you. Tap it to have a look.
from_keep: That one gave me another idea.

keep._when: Speak on the 1st keep of the visit, the 3rd, then every 4th (7th, 11th...). Otherwise stay quiet: the animation and the live region are enough.
keep.first_ever: That's in your book now. It's up at the top, and it stays on this device.
third: Three in the book. I'm starting to see what you like.
Three kept. I'd say you're after {cluster_label}.

dismiss._when: Speak on the 1st dismiss of the visit only. After that, the undo line is enough.
dismiss.first: Fair enough. Fewer like that, then.

swipe_hint: Swipe right to keep one, or left if it's not for you.

book.full: Your book's full, so I've taken out the oldest one to make room.
book.no_storage: I can't keep a book on this device, so these are just for today.

room_empty: That's everything I've got in here. Try next door.
diet_clash: I've taken the {title} away. It isn't {diet}.

write_out.remaining: I can write out {n} more today.
write_out.remaining_one: I can write out one more today.
write_out.at_cap: That's three I've written out today. The short version's above.
write_out.failed: My pen's run dry. The short version's above. Try again in a bit.
